description: Public stand-in for a record held in a host's private store (kenning docs/private-store.md). Published in the owner's public repo at the same record key as the private record it refers to, so the reference is portable and survives a host move; the private record itself is served by `host` only after that host's access check.

main.description: One private record's public stub. Same rkey as the subject (for Astra: the collection's publish slug). A newer stub at the same rkey (later updatedAt) supersedes an older one, e.g. after moving hosts.

subject.description: URI of the private record this stub stands in for, e.g. at://<did>/gallery.astra.collection/<slug>.

subjectCid.description: CID of the private record when the stub was signed, so a viewer with access can detect a stale host copy.

host.description: Base URL of the host that currently serves the private record (Astra: ASTRA_PUBLIC_URL).

visibility.description: kenning Visibility string that gates the subject; for a stub this is always a private value, `circle:<name>`.

updatedAt.description: When this stub was written. Later wins.
